lines.en: I pace up and down the corridor.

lines.zh: 我的钩子轻轻碰着栏杆。
lines.en: My hook taps lightly on the railing.
I walk to the window and turn back.
The floorboards complain under me.
I tilt my head and look around as I walk.
My steps fall deep, then shallow.

lines.zh: 窗帘的影子从我身上滑过。
lines.en: Curtain shadows slide over me.

lines.zh: 我在同一个地方走了很多遍。
lines.en: I've walked the same stretch many times.
My cloth sways a little in the draft.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，今天不赶时间。
lines.en: I walk slowly; there's no hurry today.
I circle the room along the wall.
I stand in the dark without moving.
My single eye sweeps the corner.
I lift the hook and look at it.
My gears tick softly.
I keep my head tilted, listening.
I smooth a corner of my cloth.
I lean on the wall, not sleeping.

lines.zh: 我抬头看天花板上的洞。
lines.en: I look up at the hole in the ceiling.

lines.zh: 我伸出一只手，又收回来。
lines.en: I reach a hand out, then take it back.
You leave me alone, I leave you alone.

lines.zh: 我只在挨打之后才还手。
lines.en: I only hit back after I'm hit.
By daylight I'm just decoration.

lines.zh: 你现在看到的是哪个我？
lines.en: Which me are you seeing right now?
Don't stare too long; I'll remember.
Keep your hands off my fabric.
I've stood here for years.
Take a step back.
I don't want trouble.

lines.zh: 壳凹进去了，齿轮还在动。
lines.en: The shell dented; the gears still work.
My head is knocked to one side.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，把钩子抬起来。
lines.en: I step back and raise the hook.
A seam has split in my fabric.
It doesn't hurt, but I remember it.
The gear in my elbow jams, then releases
I stagger into the wall.
An iron plate falls out of me.
I slowly push it back in.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸声不知道从哪来。
lines.en: I don't know where that rasping comes from.
I don't eat, and you needn't feed me.
There's only iron and cloth inside me.
That's useless to me.
Put the food away.
This cloth shell cannot smell a thing
I'm not hungry, and I can't be.
Bring something else.
That's not what I want.
You bump me and I sway.

lines.zh: 我的钩子刮到你的袖子。
lines.en: My hook scrapes your sleeve.

lines.zh: 你的肩撞上我胸口那只钩
lines.en: Your shoulder strikes the hook on my chest
You've pushed me against the wall.
I step back and let you pass.
That knock left my head crooked.
I slowly set it straight.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道留在我布上。
lines.en: Your smell is on my fabric now.
The others won't come near.

lines.zh: 我们各自站在自己的位置。
lines.en: We each stand in our own spot.
I hear its joints creaking.
Three shadows on the stage.
We never walk together.
Its fabric is a little newer.
I raise a hand; it doesn't answer.

lines.zh: 我们只是同一个地方的东西。
lines.en: We're just things from the same place.
At night we stand, each alone.
None of us is a companion.
I'll keep this cloth to patch myself.
A circuit board, back into the chest.
I pick up an old coin.

lines.zh: 我费了点力气才弯下去。
lines.en: It takes me some effort to bend.
Iron scraps are useful too.
I drop it into my cloth pocket.
I remember things that fall.
That loose screw is one of mine.
I tuck it into the corner.
You hit me, didn't you.
Then we start now.
First I fix where you're standing.
You struck first.
My single eye settles on you.
Only after a blow do I come alive.
I shift toward you.
Don't expect forgiveness.
Backing off is too late.
Fine; I'll remember this score.
Now it's my turn.
The hook is already raised.
I'm done playing decoration.
This one is just for you.

lines.zh: 我踩着你的脚印，一步不落
lines.en: I step inside your footprints, missing none
I'm not fast, but I keep coming.
I've memorized your footsteps.
I've blocked the door.
I cut the distance step by step.
You've backed behind the curtain.
I don't need to catch my breath.

lines.zh: 我的钩子在黑暗里反光。
lines.en: My hook glints in the dark.

lines.zh: 你抬手的动作我看清了。
lines.en: I saw your arm come up.
I work around to your side.
The gaps between your breaths are getting shorter
There's no other way out of here.
The hook shows at the corner first
A curtain won't stop me.

lines.zh: 我在等你的第二次动作。
lines.en: I'm waiting for your second move.
If you're running, run now.
I've come half a circle.
One step to go.
The hook opens a line.
One swipe of my palm puts it down.
My jaw clacks.
It's thrown against the wall.
Slow, but heavy.
I hold on and don't let go.
My fingers dig into fabric.

lines.zh: 它退了两步，我进了三步。
lines.en: It gives two steps; I take three.
Scraps of cloth fall everywhere.
Its shell has split.
I have no intention of stopping.
The hook goes in from the side.
It makes an awful sound.
I draw my hand back and smooth my cloth.

lines.zh: 地上的东西我没有兴趣。
lines.en: I don't care about what's on the floor.
I stand and wait until it's completely still.
I glance at the door again.
Then I slowly turn back around.
I'm standing where I always stand.

lines.zh: 窗帘动了一下，我就在了。
lines.en: The curtain stirs, and I'm there.
The curtain moved — and there I was.
I lift my hook a little.
The light is dim here. Perfect.
My single eye glows a small point.
That creak is my weight.
I'm back in this room.
I smooth my cloth.
I have no plans to chase anyone today.
I stand by the door.
Something sounds from the stage.
Fire eats the cloth; I beat at it hard.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上摔下去，散了一点。
lines.en: I fall down the stairs and come apart a little.

lines.zh: 水浸透布，我的动作变沉。
lines.en: Water soaks my cloth and my movements turn heavy.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的布掀飞一半。
lines.en: The blast tears half my cloth away.

lines.zh: 一枚子弹卡在我的肩里。
lines.en: A bullet lodges in my shoulder.
Light passes through me and I miss a beat.

lines.zh: 我不需要吃饭，可我已迟钝。
lines.en: I don't eat, yet I've grown dull.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的独眼灭了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my eye goes dark.

lines.zh: 没有地板，我这身重量没处放。
lines.en: No floor; this weight has nowhere to rest.
